mode: isolated current-source helper observations with synthetic content; no application bootstrap, credentials, network, database or provider

observations.finding: Shared parseContent preserves non-JSON HTML input; plain-text extraction does not include href attributes.
Legacy HTML plain-text extraction leaves an HTML entity encoded; it is not a canonical DOM selection-offset mapper.
Shared JSON plain-text extraction concatenates block text without separators; do not use it to infer reviewed rich-text range offsets.

limits: These observations do not establish an XSS vulnerability or a deployed redaction defect. They show that existing parser/plain-text helpers are not, by themselves, the future canonical selective-redaction mapping contract. No browser, accessibility, DB/RLS, provider, concurrency or production test was run.
